name: hud_drift_tray_asks_the_drift_in_a_build_window
description: The Drift tray offers a window's packs only once that window is open for both hollows (contract-m7.md §2, SimUndertow's one clock), on Undertow's own rules against the caretaker. In wave 2 my hollow clears first (its creeps leak at once) while the rival's still waits for the pack I corked, so my hollow stands in its window but the duel's wave runs: the simulation's Drift still names wave 2's packs (SimMatch.drift_offer() for the window just played), yet the tray shows none under 'NEXT WINDOW', a cork is refused before it goes out ('The window opens once both waves are over') and the countdown says the rival's wave still runs. Space still uncorks my bottle there (the duel's wave runs, if not on my hollow), and once it is gone a second Space does nothing: no Ready for a window that has not opened for both. When the rival's hollow clears, window 3 opens for both and the tray shows its offer, drift_offer()'s.

steps.assert: Game.state == Game.State.PREP and Game.duel_wave() and Game.sim.hollows[1].phase == 1 and Game.sim.tick < horn + 1440
steps.msg: my hollow cleared wave 2; the rival's still plays it, held for my bottle (before the client would uncork it at 24 s)
the simulation's Drift still names wave 2's packs

steps.assert: Game.drift_packs() == [] and node('DriftTray').packs_shown() == [] and node('DriftTray').find_child('Tier', true, false).text == 'NEXT WINDOW'
steps.msg: the tray shows none: window 3 has not opened for both

steps.assert: node('Countdown').text == "· your rival's wave still runs"
steps.msg: the countdown says why it stands

steps.assert: node('Notice').visible and node('Notice').text == 'The window opens once both waves are over' and resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 6).size() == 1
steps.msg: a cork is refused here, before it goes out
my bottle may be uncorked: the duel's wave runs, if not on my hollow
Space uncorked it, and said no Ready

steps.assert: resource('res://tests/ui/duel_stage.gd').sent(1, 4).size() == readies and not Game.is_ready() and not scene.controller.wants_ready()
steps.msg: a second Space does nothing while the duel's wave runs: no Ready for a window that has not opened

steps.assert: Game.sim.drift_window == 3 and Game.drift_packs() == Game.sim.drift_offer() and Game.drift_packs().size() == 3
steps.msg: window 3 open for both: its offer is the simulation's

steps.assert: node('DriftTray').packs_shown().size() == 3 and node('DriftTray').packs_shown()[0]['check'] == Game.sim.drift_offer()[0] and node('DriftTray').find_child('Tier', true, false).text == 'TIER I'
